summary: Approximately 51,180 km² and about 5.3 million people (2024), from Wikidata's Q800 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Costa Rica", at revision 1373766755, opens: "Costa Rica, officially the Republic of Costa Rica, is a country in Central America. It borders Nicaragua to the north, the Caribbean Sea to the northeast, Panama to the southeast, and the Pacific Ocean to the southwest, sharing a maritime border with Ecuador to the south of Cocos Island. It has a population of around five million in a land area of nearly 51,180 km2 (19,760 sq mi); the capital and largest city is San José, home to around 350,000 residents and two million people in the surrounding metropolitan area." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 94 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1886 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is San Jose. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
